response.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name;

assumptions.assumption: Results are grouped by MediaType.Name, so media types that share a name are combined into one row.
A track with Milliseconds = 0 has no defined length, so its bytes-per-millisecond value is treated as missing (NULLIF) and excluded from the average rather than causing an error.
Tracks with NULL Bytes fail the threshold and are excluded; the ratio is averaged per track, as the request states, rather than computed as average bytes divided by average milliseconds.

alternatives.interpretation: Group by MediaType.MediaTypeId instead of the name, so that media types sharing a name appear as separate rows, with the name shown alongside.
alternatives.sql: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name;
